    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:53.940
    | text      = Listen to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:54.820

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:58.420
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:58.739
    | text      = I know my shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:00.179
    | text      = In what fashion?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:02.579
    | text      = And I'm like trying to get the establishment, the captains here to steer us out of this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:07.619
    | text      = iceberg filled jungle we're in, or the whole fucking ship's going to go down.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:14.179
    | text      = And so you guys keep threatening me and doing all this stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:16.579

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:18.019
    | text      = Why don't you stop?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:19.139
    | text      = Why don't you take the payoffs?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:20.420

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:22.260
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:22.500
    | text      = I mean, I'll take a payoff from you guys.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:24.579
    | text      = This doesn't happen with Blanche.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:25.619
    | text      = This happened with the people above them, you know, years ago.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:27.780
    | text      = We're just kind of the world at the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:29.219
    | text      = 50 million a year to you personally, and you'll run this whole organization, but we'll be
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = in charge or we're going to destroy you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:33.619
    | text      = And I said, where you're going to take us is destroy us.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:35.699
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:35.940
    | text      = I take a payoff and sit on the deck of the Titanic and go down with it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:39.699
    | text      = I mean, if it was boss hog, you guys were just doing this or that, but you were better
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:42.739
    | text      = than the other groups.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:44.340
    | text      = And then, and the ship was going to make it to New York.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:47.780
    | text      = I'd kick my feet up and say, get me some champagne and some caviar.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:51.539
    | text      = The fucking ship's going into a goddamn iceberg.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:55.219
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:55.380
    | text      = Excuse me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:56.099
    | text      = Family show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:56.820
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:57.380
    | text      = So Alex has said this kind of thing constantly over the years where he would be fine with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:00.820
    | text      = the globalist if they were just like boss hog, the evil County commissioner from the
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:11.780

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:16.340
    | text      = in fighting them either.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:17.460

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:21.139
    | text      = They, they handled him so well.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:23.460
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:23.699
    | text      = He's a goofy caricature.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:25.219
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:25.539
    | text      = Yep.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:25.780
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:25.940
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:26.260
    | text      = But on further examination, it makes sense that Alex would be fine with boss hog.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = He's super corrupt and owns pretty much every business in hazard County, including infrastructure

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:36.659

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:37.860
    | text      = His brother-in-law is sheriff Roscoe P Coltrane.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:40.739

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:51.380
    | text      = Marjorie Taylor Greene had to live in the sunlight, and she chose to quit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:54.980

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:59.139
    | text      = on whipping into frenzies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:01.380

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = together anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
